scan.title: Scan this code on the panel
scan.description: On the panel, open Settings and tap **Scan QR code**. If it cannot read it, type the address `{url}` and the code `{code}`. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Press Submit when the panel says it is connected.

error.not_scanned: The panel has not used the code yet. If it expired, this is a new one.

abort.already_configured: This panel already exists: remove it first to add it again.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no internal URL: set one in Settings > System > Network.

intercoms.title: Intercoms
intercoms.description: The panel registers with them over SIP, to answer the door and talk to it. DMSS is not affected. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.intercoms: Choose the doorbell button of each intercom to make the panel ring when it is pressed.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Their video is shown in the panel's menu. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.cameras: If you have intercoms, choose one to offer Talk on that camera.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: The weather and the forecast next to the clock.

init.title: Panel settings
init.description: Open what you want to change. Submitting a page saves it, and the panel applies it right away.

entities.title: Sensors, siren and speaker
entities.description: What this panel exposes in Home Assistant.

data_description.sensors: Light, battery and its temperature, overheating, charging, Wi-Fi signal, app version and presence, guessed from sudden changes of light. Off: Home Assistant removes those entities.
data_description.siren: Lets Home Assistant sound the panel's siren at full volume. Off: it removes the entity and the panel ignores the command.
data_description.speaker: A media player for tts.speak and any other audio. Off: it removes the entity.

rtsp.title: Publish the camera
rtsp.description: Creates a camera entity in Home Assistant. The panel's camera is only on while something is watching, and the panel shows it and keeps its screen on: Frigate or anything that records keeps it on all the time. Anyone on the home network who has the password can see it. Others, such as Frigate, connect to `{url}`, so give the panel a fixed address.

data_description.rtsp_password: Leave it empty to generate one. The user is always marc2d.
data_description.rtsp_audio: Also sends the panel's microphone: whoever watches can hear the room. The droid's eye shows it. Check the law where you live before recording conversations.

voice.title: Voice commands
voice.description: The panel listens for its wake phrase on the device. Only what follows is sent to Home Assistant. It downloads a 40 MB model the first time, and anyone near the panel can give orders to what is exposed to Assist.

data_description.pipeline: Needs speech-to-text. Empty uses the preferred assistant.
data_description.wake_phrase: Say it alone, with a pause before and after. Short, unusual phrases work best. It has to use words of the panel's Spanish model: with any other word it never reacts. Empty uses jarvis.
